synthesis: SendEndOfShiftSummary exhausts its 5 retries with a Postgres SQLSTATE[57014] statement timeout while building a closed shift's summary email. handle() runs entirely inside DB::connection('platform')->transaction(); the one raw-SQL query on that connection is BuildShiftSummary::buildZoneSummaries() (app/Services/Scout/BuildShiftSummary.php:178-193): an un-fenced spatial JOIN between the giant partitioned public.scans and platform.zones via ST_Contains, scoped only by kit_id + [started_at, ended_at]. For a large/long-stale window Postgres can blow statement_timeout evaluating the spatial predicate before narrowing rows. Same family as DEV-2309 but a different, unfixed call site — DEV-2309 (PR #309) only fixed Eloquent Scan::query() aggregates on 'zod' (CloseInactiveShiftsCommand::latestActivityFor, EnsureOpenShift), not this hand-written SQL on 'platform'.

scope.summary: Bound the scans⋈zones spatial join in buildZoneSummaries() so Postgres filters public.scans to the shift's kit_id+time window BEFORE evaluating ST_Contains. Separately confirm/tighten AC-3 surfacing (failed() already logs + records a generically-labeled skip reason).

proposed_changes.change: Rewrite raw SQL in buildZoneSummaries() (178-193) to pre-filter public.scans by kit_id + scanned_at BETWEEN into a bounded set (WITH shift_scans AS MATERIALIZED (...) or two-step) before joining to platform.zones via ST_Contains.
proposed_changes.reason: Forces the planner to compute the shift's small scan set first — same philosophy as DEV-2309, different table pair/connection.

proposed_changes.change: AC-3 (pending human decision): possibly relabel generic 'mail_failed' skip reason to a build/query-accurate value, and/or wire a proactive alert (Horizon::routeSlackNotificationsTo, currently commented out).
proposed_changes.reason: failed() (125-141) already logs + persists summary_skipped_reason, but the label assumes mail-transport failure though most exhaustion causes (DB timeout, CH outage) happen before Mail::send().

proposed_changes.change: Add a pinning test exercising buildZoneSummaries() end-to-end (scans + zones seeded on a shared connection) asserting correct per-zone stats after the rewrite.
proposed_changes.reason: Existing test class docblock (17-25) documents this join is NOT covered because scans (zod) and zones (platform) sit in separate RefreshDatabase transactions.

out_of_scope: handle()'s long platform transaction wrapping CH+Mail+PG join while holding lockForUpdate (secondary)
New indexes (existing adequate for a fenced query)
ClickHouse queries in the summary path (not implicated in a PG 57014)

acceptance_criteria.item: SendEndOfShiftSummary completes without SQLSTATE[57014] timeouts (verify against laravel.log post-deploy).
acceptance_criteria.reason: Requires a query-shape fix, not catch-and-degrade — a caught 57014 still appears in laravel.log, failing this AC's own verification.

acceptance_criteria.item: The timing-out query in the summary path is bounded/optimized.
acceptance_criteria.reason: buildZoneSummaries() at 178-193; fix via pre-filter fence (MATERIALIZED CTE or two-step).

acceptance_criteria.item: Retry-exhaustion no longer silently drops a summary — it alerts or records a skip reason.
acceptance_criteria.reason: failed() (125-141) already logs + persists summary_skipped_reason='mail_failed' (DEV-1788). Literal AC met by existing code; open question is label accuracy and/or proactive alert.

questions.q: Does DEV-2309's merged fix already cover this ticket?
questions.answer: No. DEV-2309 (PR #309, merged) fixed Eloquent Scan::query() aggregates on 'zod'; DEV-2325's query is raw SQL on 'platform' in buildZoneSummaries() — different table pair (scans⋈zones vs scans⋈timezones) and call site, untouched by that PR.

questions.q: Is the existing failed()-hook sufficient for AC-3, or does the ticket want a NEW proactive alert (Slack/PagerDuty/notification)?
Should 'mail_failed' be relabeled (e.g. 'build_failed') since most exhaustion causes occur before Mail::send(), or is the generic label acceptable?
Will the MATERIALIZED-CTE rewrite keep the query under production statement_timeout at real scale, or is a covering/composite index also needed?

notes: 'platform' and 'zod' are the SAME physical Postgres DB, differentiated only by search_path ('platform' vs 'public') — config/database.php:58-121. Raw SQL schema-qualifies public.scans because it runs on the 'platform'-search_path connection.

BuildShiftSummaryTest.php docblock (17-25) documents the scans⋈zones join is untested because scans (zod) and zones (platform) sit in separate RefreshDatabase transactions; new test needs scans seeded on the platform connection.
DEV-2220 rejected 'SET LOCAL statement_timeout' for this family — fix the query shape.
DEV-2309's test technique (enableQueryLog() + assert emitted SQL shape) is a good template.
Latent risk (NOT in scope): ClientSearchScansResource.php:92 runs Scan::query()->forOrg() WITHOUT withoutGlobalScope — every render/count carries the scans⋈timezones join; follow-up ticket.
handle()'s whole body (CH calls + PG join + Mail::send + save) runs in one platform transaction holding lockForUpdate on kit_shifts (62-117) — secondary risk, not required by ACs.

Horizon scaffolds failed-job Slack/mail routing but it's commented out (HorizonServiceProvider.php:19-21); no LOG_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in .env.example — no proactive alert channel wired for any job today.

tests.what_it_pins: buildZoneSummaries() returns correct per-zone scan/hit/minute counts with scans+zones seeded on a shared connection; pins post-fix query shape.
If AC-3 label changes, assert the new skip-reason value on retry exhaustion.

grounding.scans_ddl: vendor zod-schema.sql:3994-4009 (PARTITION BY RANGE scanned_at); kit_id / kit_id+scanned_at btree + geo GiST per partition
